Alright - here we go. I posted this a long time ago on Reddit, so I am copying it from my comment history. New years '97 to '98 I went to New York City for the whole Time Square showdown. I lived in North Carolina (still do) and I went with my best friend and two other guys - twin brothers originally from New Jersey, just south of the state line from New York; so they were anxious to go. The creepy part happened on the way back. We were driving on I-95 south and had just passed through the Washington DC area. After a while, I see a sign (we made the trip in my car, and I drove the whole way as I had a stick shift and they didn't know how to drive it) that said DC was about 30 miles away from where we were. I thought this was strange, as we had just passed through DC a while back - I figured there was maybe some switchback ahead that would take us back there or something as it made no sense to see a sign like that after already passing through. Anyways, we travel a little further and see another sign for DC even closer. Now I start paying attention. The twin brothers were sitting in the back seat, and my other friend was asleep in the front passenger seat, but apparently one of the guys in the back were paying attention as well and asked "Are we headed back to DC?" I said I dont see how we could be, but before long we passed a sign that said we were headed on I-95 going north! Well, I took an exit, turned around and started heading south again. At this point the front passenger woke up and we were all a little confused as to how we got turned around; and I determined to make sure that I didn't get turned back around again - so I made sure to pay really close attention to make sure I did not veer off somewhere. Before long I passed a rest stop that I remembered passing before and the same guy in the back even commented that he remembered passing here earlier too, so I made a comment that we obviously got turned around somewhere after here. We went on for about 40 miles or so after that point until finally going far enough that it was apparent that we did not make it this far before, and I made a point to note every exit on the way or anything that I possibly could have taken to get off the I-95 south route, and there was nothing that I could have taken without me realizing it. So - somehow, somewhere just south of DC we went from going south on 95 to going north with no way to explain it - and there were two other conscious witnesses to back it up. I have no idea how to explain this to this day. It's just one of those things that my mind has no choice but to file away in the WTF drawer.
